answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can earn, and build a verifiable work history first. Each new identity must pay again and complete auditable tasks, so creating thousands of fakes multiplies the attacker's cost instead of multiplying influence. Like pigment that cannot be separated from paint once mixed, past work stays attached to one identity and cannot be copied to a clone. A bridge between earned reputation and voting weight then caps power: influence grows only from attested work, never from account count, leaving sable fakes expensive and easy to ignore.
